newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends unchanged in sluggish trade.

text.p: Taiwan's dollar closed unchanged against its U.S. counterpart in quiet Saturday trade but dealers said the local currency should trend downward next week.
The Taiwan dollar finished unchanged from Friday's T$27.495 close. Turnover was a very thin US$40.5 million in the short Saturday session.
The Taiwan dollar fell slightly in earlier trade in response to the U.S. dollar's strength overseas but the fall was offset by small but persistent entries of foreign equity funds, dealers said.
"There are very few participants in the market. We all have nothing to do," said one dealer.
Dealers said the rate might test the T$27.50 support next week, but any major movements were unlikely.
